relationships.evidence_quote: In 2015, Chiang et al. showed that RvD2 is an agonist of GPR18 (Figure 1) [16].

relationships.evidence_quote: decreased the expression of matrix metalloproteinase-9 (MMP-9), aquaporin-4 (AQP4)—proteins related to the integrity of blood-brain barrier (BBB)

relationships.subject: resolvin D2
relationships.evidence_quote: the level of interleukin-6 (IL-6) and tumour necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-α) was significantly lower in infarcted brain tissue following MCAO/R, suggesting a neuroprotective role for RvD2

key_findings: Review of the GPR18-RvD2 axis and small-molecule GPR18 ligands in inflammation resolution.
RvD2 pharmacology is complicated by metabolic instability and assay-dependent ligand behaviour at GPR18.
